_readme: Site glossary for en/ (Nextcloud). shared = WoowTech series names and chrome terms reused across the 13 sites (kept verbatim from the kit seed); terms = Nextcloud / Home Assistant add-on / WebDAV / CalDAV / sharing domain terms (upstream English UI and docs wording wins); keepEnglish = never translate or rephrase; forbid = words the reviewer rejects. decisions = the binding cross-chapter wording agreed before the 22 chapters + 3 appendices + 5 hub pages were translated in parallel: h2 forms, data-nav labels, callout labels, table headers, code placeholders, prose examples and localize substitutions. Companion binding table: /home/user/out/terms_nextcloud.txt
principles: Upstream English UI and docs wording wins (nextcloud.com, docs.nextcloud.com user/admin manuals, the Nextcloud web UI, Home Assistant).

Nextcloud app and object names stay verbatim in English: Files, Photos, Calendar, Contacts, Talk, Deck, Office, Notes, Tasks, Dashboard, Activity, Apps, Settings, Administration settings, Trash bin, File drop, App password.
Product names, CLI commands, config keys, file names, ports, hostnames and placeholders stay verbatim; Chinese placeholders become <your-...> style via i18n/_proposals only.
US spelling; sentence case for headings, nav and buttons; Title Case for product and WoowTech series names.
Second person 'you'; direct, like a senior engineer onboarding a beginner; no 'In this chapter we will', no marketing adjectives, no emoji.

Callout labels are fixed: Concept: / Tip: / Warning: / Danger:; full-width punctuation becomes ASCII; the pages use full-width slash '/' and '+' freely (CalDAV/CardDAV, .docx/.xlsx, 22 chapters + 3 appendices) - all become plain ASCII.
Security wording is load-bearing: 最小暴露 is always 'minimal exposure', 最小權限 is 'least privilege', 分享連結 is always a 'share link', 收回 is 'revoke'. Never soften a Danger callout.
第 N 章 -> Chapter N; 附錄 A/B/C -> Appendix A/B/C; 圖 N-M -> Figure N-M. Numbers, versions and dates stay exactly as the Chinese source has them.

stuck point (for 卡關 - use pitfall)

decisions._readme: Binding cross-chapter wording. If a page can render a phrase two ways, use the form here. Every distinct zh h2 has exactly ONE fixed English form; the #why h2 is chapter-specific and translated literally (Why this matters is the data-nav label only). data-nav on sales/prompts/skills is already an English slug in the zh source (why, what, cat-files...) - copy those verbatim, do not translate them.

h2_by_section.sources: Official sources - 官方來源 is identical on all 25 chapter/appendix pages.
h2_by_section.faq: <Topic> FAQ - the zh h2 is <topic>常見問題 and the qualifier is kept (安裝常見問題 = Install FAQ, Talk 常見問題 = Talk FAQ). Bare 常見問題 on sales.html / prompts.html / skills.html is plain 'FAQ'.
h2_by_section.troubleshoot: Common <topic> pitfalls - the zh h2 is <topic>常見卡關. Exception: ch22#troubleshoot is 分層排錯 = 'Troubleshooting layer by layer' (not a 卡關 h2).
h2_by_section.steps: <Number> steps to <verb phrase> - keep the Chinese numeral (六步 = Six steps, 五步 = Five steps). One exception keeps the zh shape: 六步安全檢查清單 = 'Six-step security checklist'.
h2_by_section.why: chapter-specific; translate the Chinese h2 literally in sentence case. Do NOT replace it with 'Why this matters' - that is the data-nav label only.
h2_by_section._case: Sentence case throughout. A colon-prefixed h2 keeps its prefix and takes an ASCII colon plus one space (先想清楚：… = 'Decide first: …'). Full-width parentheses become ASCII.

code_placeholders._readme: Code is frozen (gate B). Do NOT edit these in en/; file i18n/_proposals/<file>.json with the whole block verbatim as zh and the same block with ONLY the Chinese replaced as en. The hostname woowtech-nextcloud.woowtech.io always sits inside <code> - it stays verbatim everywhere, including in the WebDAV URL.
code_placeholders._prompts_html: All 30 <pre> prompt bodies on prompts.html are Chinese inside frozen code. policy.json marks the page 'rewrite', so every one needs a proposal entry, rewritten as an English prompt that also tells the agent to answer in English. Keep the API names (WebDAV, OCS API, CalDAV, CardDAV), the numbers (20, 7, 90, 30, 80%, 50GB, 15%) and the confirm-before-acting clause exactly.
code_placeholders._skills_html: skills.html #spec holds a whole SKILL.md in a frozen block. Proposal wording: name: nextcloud-share-auditor / description: Scan Nextcloud shares, flag risky ones and revoke them in bulk, with a dry-run mode / # Purpose / Use the OCS API to inventory every share and find the ones with no password, no expiry, or public access. / ## Steps / 1. Call the OCS Shares API to fetch every share / 2. Flag the risky ones and produce a "preview list" (N affected) / 3. Only after the user confirms, bulk-add passwords, set expiry dates or disable them / 4. Report the results and any exceptions / ## Safety / - Never delete a file directly, only change share settings / - Always report the blast radius before a bulk operation / - Always use an app password

localize._readme: policy = localize. Replace the Taiwan-specific framing with a generic one and add a short 'Note:' sentence whenever the substitution changes what the example demonstrates.
localize.時區設為台北 (ch5#steps): set the time zone to your own - the step is 'confirm your language and time zone', so name no city. Note: Calendar and Tasks show the wrong times until this matches where you actually are.
localize.語言設為繁體中文 (ch5#steps): set the language to the one you want (the en site says English)
localize.本站已是繁體中文介面。(ch4#faq): This site runs in English. - the question 介面語言怎麼改成中文？ becomes 'How do I change the interface language?' and keeps the pointer to Chapter 5.
localize.繁體中文 Nextcloud 教學 (tutorial.html meta de: Drop the language framing: 'A 22-chapter Nextcloud tutorial with 3 appendices: install, login, file management and sharing, then Photos, Calendar, Talk, desktop and mobile sync, admin settings, security and troubleshooting.'
localize.中文變亂碼 (ch12#troubleshoot 匯入後中文變亂碼): imported names come out as garbage - generalize to non-ASCII names, keep the UTF-8 fix
localize.中文檔名亂碼 (ch20#troubleshoot): non-ASCII filenames show as garbage - keep the UTF-8 fix and the 'switch tools' advice
localize.og:locale zh_TW / <html lang=\"zh-Hant\": og:locale en_US and lang="en" (chapters.json owner). The CC deed href is an href - gate A freezes it; leave https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.zh-hant unless the chapters.json owner changes site.license.url.
localize.詳洽經銷商 / 聯絡 WoowTech 或您的經銷商 (sales.html): Talk to WoowTech or your reseller - sales.html is transcreate; price, currency and contact channel stay placeholders until the business brief lands. No TWD, no NT$.
localize.NOT PRESENT - do not introduce: LINE, 台電 (Taipower), Asia/Taipei, TWD/NT$, 統編, 中華電信 appear nowhere on this site. 多台電腦 in ch18 is 'multiple computers', not Taipower. Do not invent a localized equivalent for something the source never said. Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud, Trello, DAVx5 and 月費 (monthly fee) are already global and stay.
